page.description: Pop!_OS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: System76's Ubuntu-based desktop, built for their own laptops and usable on any PC. One LTS image for 64-bit Intel and AMD machines.
pros: Based on an Ubuntu LTS base, with System76's own desktop and tools.
An NVIDIA-ready image exists for machines that need the driver at install time.
Automatic window tiling and a keyboard-first workflow.
One image per use case instead of a long edition list.
cons: Only x86_64 generic images are published for this release.
No end-of-life date is published on the download page.
Hardware enablement is tuned around System76's own machines.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of Pop!_OS 21.04 with COSMIC from Wikimedia Commons. It is not 24.04 and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.alt: Pop!_OS 21.04 desktop with COSMIC, the applications overview and a terminal
shot.caption: Stock screenshot of Pop!_OS 21.04 · not 24.04, no USB written, no boot tested.

page.status: One image per driver setup: the generic or the NVIDIA ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The date is the official mirror's file date (2026-09-17); System76 publishes no separate release date on this page.
